[LHYD.5.1] When the adapter has asserted the last fact of a hydration it
emits a single `HydrationComplete` fact, `ttl`-scoped at 5_min. It is emitted
once per hydration call, after every matching fact has been asserted, and
signals that rules matching on the hydrated set may fire. It is the hydration
call's response fact ([LCRS.4.3.1]): every hydration service declares
`response HydrationComplete` ([LADP.8.4.2]).

| Slot | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `corr` | String | correlation id from the `as` binding |
| `schema_name` | String | schema name queried |
| `count` | Int | facts asserted this hydration |
| `truncated` | Bool | whether the call hit its `limit:` |
| `t_start` | Float | window start, epoch seconds |
| `t_end` | Float | window end, approximately the call time |
